name: Daily #1: ROT13 Warmup
description: Decode this message: 'synt{ebg13_vf_rnfl}'. It's a simple substitution cipher.
hints: ROT13 rotates each letter 13 positions in the alphabet.

name: Daily #2: Binary Basics
hints: Each 8-bit sequence represents one ASCII character.

name: Daily #3: Morse Mystery
hints: Use a Morse code translator. Dots and dashes represent letters.

name: Daily #4: ASCII Art
hints: Convert decimal ASCII values to their corresponding characters.

name: Daily #5: Backwards Thinking
hints: Read the string from right to left.

name: Daily #6: Octal Oddity
hints: Convert octal (base-8) numbers to ASCII characters.

name: Daily #7: URL Encoded
hints: URL encoding uses %XX for special characters. Use a URL decoder.

name: Daily #8: XOR Simple
description: XOR each character of 'EKCI' with the key '5' (ASCII 53). The result is your flag format.
hints: XOR each byte with 53. The result spells 'flag{xor1}'.

name: Daily #9: Atbash Cipher
description: Decrypt this Atbash cipher: 'uozt{zgyzhs_rksvih}'. A becomes Z, B becomes Y, etc.
hints: Atbash reverses the alphabet: A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X, etc.

name: Daily #10: Leetspeak
hints: Replace numbers with letters: 4=a, 3=e, 7=t, 1=i, 5=s, 0=o

name: Daily #11: Brainfuck Intro
hints: Use an online Brainfuck interpreter to execute this code.

name: Daily #12: NATO Phonetic
description: Decode this NATO phonetic alphabet: 'Foxtrot Lima Alpha Golf { November Alpha Tango Oscar }'
hints: Each word represents a letter in the NATO phonetic alphabet.

name: Daily #13: Pig Latin
hints: In Pig Latin, the first consonant moves to the end and 'ay' is added.

name: Daily #14: Braille Dots
hints: Use a Braille translator to convert dots to text.

name: Daily #15: Rail Fence
description: Decode this Rail Fence cipher (3 rails): 'f_afnelgacrie{l_}'
hints: Rail Fence cipher writes text in a zigzag pattern across rails.

name: Daily #16: Vigenère Lite
hints: Use a Vigenère cipher decoder with the key 'KEY'.

name: Daily #17: Keyboard Shift
description: This was typed with hands shifted one key right: 'r;sh{lruninpsr/ptovr}'
hints: Each letter was typed one key to the right on a QWERTY keyboard.

name: Daily #18: Soundex Code
description: Find the word with Soundex code F240 that completes: 'flag{____}'
hints: Soundex F240 represents 'flag'.

name: Daily #19: T9 Texting
hints: On old phone keypads: 2=ABC, 3=DEF, 4=GHI, 5=JKL, 6=MNO, 7=PQRS, 8=TUV, 9=WXYZ

name: Daily #20: Polybius Square
hints: Polybius square uses 2-digit numbers to represent letters in a 5x5 grid.
